page_title: BOC 1-3 MON | Bochum v B. Monchengladbach 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) picks up a yellow card.
90+10' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Felix Brych blows for a foul.
90+10' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+9' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner kick.
90+8' The ball is cleared after Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach win a corner kick.
90+7' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bochum due to a foul in the build-up play.
90+7' The Bochum players halt their celebrations as referee Felix Brych makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
90+5' Goal! The rebound fell to Anthony Losilla (Bochum) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:3.

90+5' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Bochum can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
90+2' Tony Jantschke (B. Monchengladbach) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

90+1' Manuel Riemann pulls off a decent save! Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Felix Brych blows his whistle as Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tony Jantschke (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch for Rocco Reitz.
86' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

85' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
81' Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
80' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Felix Brych blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
79' Bochum seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
77' The linesman signals that Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
77' Philipp Forster (Bochum) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
75' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

75' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Good work from B. Monchengladbach as they win a corner.
74' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

73' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
72' A substitution has been made. Florian Neuhaus goes off and Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
72' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Alassane Plea will be replaced by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach).
72' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
71' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
70' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Lukas Daschner (Bochum) inside the box.
68' 1 - 3 Anthony Losilla (Bochum) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.
68' That will be all from Takuma Asano who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum).
67' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
66' A cross by Takuma Asano (Bochum) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
65' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Philipp Forster (Bochum), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
64' Felix Brych interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach). Bochum will take a free kick.
64' Gerardo Seoane is forced to make a change. Nico Elvedi is unable to continue due to injury, Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
64' Problems for Gerardo Seoane as Jordan Siebatcheu is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) replaces him.
62' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
61' The game is interrupted now, Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
59' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) sends a chip pass into the box, but Moritz Nicolas is quickest to intercept the ball.

58' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Moritz Nicolas makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.

57' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Manuel Riemann pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the top right corner.
57' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

57' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
56' Florian Neuhaus plays a beautiful lofted pass to Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach), who somehow crashes the ball well wide of the left post from a promising position.
56' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

55' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and B. Monchengladbach manage to earn a corner.
54' What a chance that is! Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
53' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
53' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
52' Bernardo (Bochum) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
51' Philipp Forster (Bochum) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

50' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Manuel Riemann is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
47' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
47' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) commits a rough foul. Felix Brych stops the game and makes a call. A free kick has been awarded to B. Monchengladbach.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Kevin Stoger comes off for Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Maximilian Wittek is replaced by Philipp Forster (Bochum).
46' Thomas Letsch has made a change at the break. Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) has come on in place of Felix Passlack.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' 0 - 3 Goal! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Manuel Riemann had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:3.
45+1' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' Bochum work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
43' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Felix Brych has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
37' 0 - 2 Goal! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) meets a headed pass from Maximilian Wober and puts the ball into the net with a powerful header. He makes it 0:2.
37' Corner kick. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is ready to send the ball into the box.

36' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for B. Monchengladbach.
35' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
34' Dangerous play by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach). Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
32' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
32' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bochum.
32' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
30' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Alassane Plea slips it to Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 0:1.
25' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Bochum failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
22' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
19' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Franck Honorat, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar.
19' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
19' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
17' A rebound falls at the feet of Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
16' Felix Passlack (Bochum) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

15' A big rebound falls at the feet of Maximilian Wittek (Bochum). He doesn't hesitate and unleashes a shot towards goal, but it fails to get through a wall of players and ricochets away off one of his own teammates.
13' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Brych interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
11' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) sends a long ball in, but Moritz Nicolas comfortably gathers the ball.
10' Golden chance! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
10' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

9' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Moritz Nicolas!
7' Matus Bero is being substituted because of an injury. Thomas Letsch sends Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) on the pitch.
6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
5' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' Matus Bero (Bochum) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
4' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but it's cleared.

3' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. B. Monchengladbach get a corner.

2' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
1' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed.
Today's referee will be Felix Brych.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
